description: Find BPJ tools by name, slug, English or Chinese keywords, or category. Use includeSchema for inputs and examples. Continue with nextOffset. The empty call includes the original catalogue and the first 100 suite tools.

category.description: Optional exact category ID from the categories returned with every search.

includeSchema.description: Include descriptions, input schemas and runnable examples for up to 10 matches.

limit.description: Maximum results, up to 10 when includeSchema is true. Filtered searches default to 10.

offset.description: Pass the nextOffset from the previous result with the same filters.

query.description: Search terms, tool ID or MCP name.

name: list_bpj_ai_tools
